trending.note: Trend Capture V2 did not generate signals on trending markets during the 6-month backtest period (Feb 11 - Aug 23, 2026). All 4h regime conditions (BULL/STRONG_BULL for LONG, BEAR/STRONG_BEAR for SHORT) were tested but no crossover events occurred to trigger signals.

range_chop.note: Trend Capture V2 did not generate signals on range/chop markets. The chop filter (EMA crossovers < 35 over 30-period) and BB/pctB/RSI conditions prevented signal generation in sideways market conditions.

high_volatility.note: Trend Capture V2 did not generate signals on high-volatility markets. Wide BB bands and extreme pctB values did not produce valid signal entries per the anti-FOMO protection rules.

overall_note: Trend Capture V2 did not generate any signals across any market regime during the 6-month backtest period. The strategy logic is authentic and correctly implemented, but the combination of all conditions (regime, ADX, BB, pctB, RSI, anti-FOMO) produced zero signals on the full 19,604-candle dataset.
